facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton, Melbourne was designed by architect Cottee Parker with interiors by BAR Studio.
facts.excerpt: Designed by architect Cottee Parker with interiors by acclaimed designer BAR Studio

facts.text: The hotel has an extensive original art collection.
facts.excerpt: Anchoring these stories is The Ritz-Carlton, Melbourne’s extensive original art collection.

facts.text: Atria offers a seasonal tasting menu at a 19-metre Chef's Table.
facts.excerpt: A seasonal tasting menu experienced up close at our 19-metre Chef's Table.

facts.text: Atria and Cameo are on Level 80 of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located on Level 80 of The Ritz-Carlton, Melbourne, our Atria and Cameo restaurants

facts.text: The spa is on Level 64 and has six treatment rooms, including a dedicated couple's suite.
facts.excerpt: Located on Level 64 of the hotel, The Ritz-Carlton Spa presents six treatment rooms, including a dedicated couple’s suite.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is the hotel's largest suite and includes an in-room sauna.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Suite spans 251 square meters

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge offers five inclusive food and drink services through the day: breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, hors d'oeuvres and cordials.
facts.excerpt: Five inclusive culinary offerings are available throughout the day; breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, hors d'oeuvres, and cordials.

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites are on floors 65 to 79.
facts.excerpt: Located on floors 65 to 79,the guest rooms and suites

facts.text: Ritz Kids can enjoy a storytime with a staff member, choosing a local story to hear.
facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids enjoy a storytime experience from one of our Ladies or Gentlemen

facts.text: The hotel is in Melbourne's central business district, close to transport, the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre and the National Gallery of Victoria.
facts.excerpt: is located within the city’s central business district, close to transport, financial services, the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, and key cultural attractions such as The National Gallery of Victoria.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Self parking is available at $85.00 per day.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is available for $85.00 per day.

facts.text: Every room and suite has a feather bed with 400-thread-count linens.
facts.excerpt: Sink into a plush feather bed with 400-thread-count linens, available in every room and suite

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give complimentary Club access.
facts.excerpt: Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

facts.text: The hotel offers a curated art journey with a private host, from its Indigenous collection to the National Gallery of Victoria.
facts.excerpt: Discover Melbourne’s artistic treasures on a curated luxury journey, with a private host guiding you from The Ritz-Carlton’s Indigenous collection to the NGV
